note: A thermal camera's palettes and gains (GAME_SPEC §13, Stage 48): design, after what LWIR cameras offer (an iron bow, white hot, black hot, a rainbow, arctic; a high gain to 150 C and a low one to 650 C). A palette: sRGB control points from its coldest (0) to its hottest (1), read straight between them in linear light, at 256 entries.
